message: The other day, I was trying to explain to my grandkids why we really should have a go-bag ready at home. You’d think I was asking them to eat their vegetables! 🍅 But then I remembered how much they love our camping trips. So, I spun it around — I told them that packing a go-bag is just like getting ready for an adventure! We laughed and started gathering some items together. It turned into a fun little project, and now they’re all excited about being prepared. Sometimes it just takes a little creativity to see the bright side! What’s your favorite way to turn a chore into a fun activity?
